summary: Frontend-only iteration 2 testing (i18n language switcher + call-bar button + case-study audio player). All three new features work end-to-end. Language switcher toggles all nav links, hero H1, agents heading, process amber pill, case-study heading, contact heading, audio caption and callbar text between HU/EN with no console errors. Call-bar renders with mailto href to epistemebudapest@gmail.com with encoded subject, is visible on desktop and correctly hidden at 375px. Audio player is present in the case-study with controls, preload='none', paused on load, source /media/episteme-hivas.mp3 returns HTTP 200 (~393KB) and does not overflow at 375px width. However, the two live LLM demos (email + lead) currently FAIL with 502 due to an OpenAI AuthenticationError in the backend — the configured OPENAI_API_KEY is invalid (LiteLLM returns 'Incorrect API key provided: sk-proj-...NCEA'). This is a backend/config regression unrelated to the frontend iteration changes but must be fixed for the live-demo acceptance criterion in the request.

critical.issue: Returns 502; backend log shows 'litellm.AuthenticationError: OpenAIException - Incorrect API key provided: sk-proj-...NCEA'. OPENAI_API_KEY in backend/.env is invalid/expired. Also observed model name 'gpt-5.4-mini' being requested — verify this is intended.

integration_issues.issue: demo-result-* never renders because backend /api/demo/{email|lead} returns 502 (invalid OpenAI key). Frontend integration wiring itself is correct.

action_items: Replace OPENAI_API_KEY in /app/backend/.env with a valid key (current key ending ...NCEA is rejected by OpenAI). Restart backend after update. Also verify model id 'gpt-5.4-mini' is the intended model.
After key fix, re-run email + lead demos to confirm demo-result-* appears with localized field labels.
critical_code_review_comments: i18n.js is a single 240-line file mixing translations for both languages — acceptable for now but will grow; consider splitting to /i18n/hu.js and /i18n/en.js when translations expand.
CaseStudy.jsx correctly guards audio with onError -> episteme-audio-error fallback; matches spec.
Nav.jsx callbar uses simple <a href={mailto}> — matches 'plain link (no popup/modal)' requirement.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for new iteration features (i18n + callbar + audio); live-demo flow blocked by backend key

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration-2 UI features verified on preview URL. Only failing acceptance item is live demos due to invalid OPENAI_API_KEY (AuthenticationError logged in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log). After key rotation, only need to re-verify demo-run-email + demo-run-lead — do not re-consume LLM budget on other items.
rca of the issue: Live demo 502 -> backend calls litellm.completion(model=gpt-5.4-mini) -> OpenAI returns 401 AuthenticationError because OPENAI_API_KEY in backend/.env is invalid/revoked (key suffix ...NCEA). Server converts the exception into a 502 response to the client. Mitigation: update OPENAI_API_KEY to a valid key and confirm model id.
